envelope.description: Add the pure lifecycle rules module

body.title: Add the pure lifecycle rules module
body.summary: Add src/workflow/artifact-core/lifecycle.ts with the closed LIFECYCLE_TABLE and assertLegalStatusChange, contentHash with its canonical JSON that honours toJSON, ContentView, TransitionDetail, Integrity, checkHeadIntegrity, checkIntegrity (a log with no revision-bearing entry is no history, an empty stored hash has nothing to compare), reconcileLifecycle, the canonical-hash content-changed test, and transition. Nothing calls it yet.
acceptanceChecks: every one of the thirteen lifecycle operations from every one of the ten statuses either lands where the table says or throws IllegalTransitionError
contentHash is equal for equal content in any key order, differs for a description, body or citations change, and ignores references, parent, attachments, binding and lifecycle

reconcileLifecycle keeps approval, review and signoff at their original revision numbers after a content change that returns the status to draft, leaves the revision alone for an identical rewrite of a head with an empty stored hash, refuses a content change on a terminal artifact and a create that is not draft
checkHeadIntegrity and checkIntegrity report each reason and treat an empty stored hash and a log with no revision-bearing entry as ok

tests.name: src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/content-hash.test.ts: contentHash ignores key order and everything but the description and payload
src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/lifecycle-table.test.ts: every lifecycle operation from every status lands where the closed table says or throws IllegalTransitionError
src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/lifecycle-transition.test.ts: transition sets approval, review, signoff and stale as the table says and refuses a missing detail
src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/lifecycle-transition.test.ts: approve on a DEF, HLD or LLD needs a review bound to the current revision or an override, and a PLAN, ISSUE or SPEC needs none

src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/lifecycle-reconcile.test.ts: a create, an identical rewrite, a head with an empty stored hash, a description-only change, a reference-only change and a forged revision
src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/lifecycle-reconcile.test.ts: reconcileLifecycle after a content change to an approved artifact with a review and a signoff
src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/lifecycle-reconcile.test.ts: a content change on a terminal artifact and a create that is not draft are refused
src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/lifecycle-integrity.test.ts: checkHeadIntegrity and checkIntegrity report every reason and treat unhashed and unlogged heads as ok
